part_functions.name: Cylindrical-object support
part_functions.function: Provides a broad concave saddle surface for locating and supporting a pipe, tube, roller, or other cylindrical member.

part_functions.name: Load distribution
part_functions.function: Distributes contact loading from the curved seating surface into the longitudinal side walls, end closures, and bottom perimeter rim.

part_functions.name: Weight-efficient hollow construction
part_functions.function: Uses an open-bottom internal cavity and a thin curved web to reduce material while retaining a stiff outer envelope.

section_functions.name: Curved load-bearing web
section_functions.function: The central shell spans between the two side-wall systems and conforms to a cylindrical supported member; its coaxial inner and outer cylindrical surfaces create an approximately 0.2 mm thick curved web.

section_functions.name: Relationship to surrounding sections
section_functions.function: The saddle shell is centered between the side walls, symmetric about X=0 and Y=0, and transfers contact loads toward the side walls and end closures.

feature_functions.name: Cylindrical interface
feature_functions.function: Forms the primary concave contact interface, with a 4.215 mm cylindrical radius and axis parallel to X.

feature_functions.name: Load transfer
feature_functions.function: Receives distributed contact pressure and carries it across the width into the side walls and along the length toward the end lands.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Primary upper concave saddle surface, radius 4.215 mm, spanning X=-1 to 1 and Y=-2.4 to 2.4.

feature_functions.name: Hollow-shell backing surface
feature_functions.function: Defines the underside of the curved saddle web and the roof of the open-bottom cavity.

feature_functions.name: Controlled shell thickness
feature_functions.function: Its 4.415 mm radius is coaxial with the seating surface and produces an approximately 0.2 mm radial web thickness.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Internal concave cavity-roof surface, radius 4.415 mm, bounded laterally at X=-0.8 and X=0.8.

sections.name: Left and right longitudinal side-wall systems

section_functions.name: Longitudinal reinforcement
section_functions.function: The paired side walls act as deep ribs along the full part length, supporting the curved shell and resisting bending or spreading under saddle loads.

section_functions.name: Cavity definition
section_functions.function: Outer faces at X=±1 define the external width, while inner faces at X=±0.8 define the cavity width and create nominally 0.2 mm thick side walls.

section_functions.name: Symmetric structural relationship
section_functions.function: The left and right wall systems mirror one another about the X=0 center plane and connect the upper saddle shell to the bottom rim and end closures.

feature_functions.name: Exterior support wall
feature_functions.function: Provides the right-hand external boundary and carries loads from the saddle surface toward the bottom and end regions.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Right exterior side face at X=1, extending over the full Y=-3 to 3 length.

feature_functions.name: Cavity side boundary
feature_functions.function: Bounds the cavity on the right and works with the exterior right wall to form a stiff longitudinal rib.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Right internal cavity side face at X=0.8, following the saddle and end-wall profile.

feature_functions.name: Exterior support wall
feature_functions.function: Provides the left-hand external boundary and mirrors the right exterior wall for balanced load transfer.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Left exterior side face at X=-1, extending over the full Y=-3 to 3 length.

feature_functions.name: Cavity side boundary
feature_functions.function: Bounds the cavity on the left and works with the exterior left wall to form the second longitudinal reinforcing rib.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Left internal cavity side face at X=-0.8, symmetric with face 3 about X=0.

sections.name: Front and back end closures with upper lands

section_functions.name: End stiffening
section_functions.function: The two end closures tie the side walls together, terminate the hollow cavity, and resist distortion of the saddle shell.

section_functions.name: End bearing lands
section_functions.function: Flat upper lands at both ends provide robust edge regions adjoining the curved seat and reduce fragility at the saddle termination.

section_functions.name: Symmetric structural relationship
section_functions.function: Front and back closures are mirrored about Y=0 and connect the outer envelope to the internal cavity roof and walls.

features.name: Front end wall and transition lands

feature_functions.name: Front cavity closure
feature_functions.function: Closes and stiffens the negative-Y end while connecting the exterior end face, upper bearing land, internal end wall, and cavity-roof land.

feature_functions.name: Physical behavior
feature_functions.function: Acts as a transverse diaphragm that restrains side-wall spreading and transfers end-region loads into the bottom rim.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Front exterior end face at Y=-3, spanning the complete external width and height.
Front upper horizontal land at Z=0.75 between Y=-3 and Y=-2.4, adjacent to the exterior end and curved seat.
Front internal cavity end wall at Y=-2.8, extending from the bottom opening to Z=0.55.
Front internal horizontal roof land at Z=0.55, joining the internal end wall to the cylindrical cavity roof.

features.name: Back end wall and transition lands

feature_functions.name: Back cavity closure
feature_functions.function: Closes and stiffens the positive-Y end while connecting the exterior end face, upper bearing land, internal end wall, and cavity-roof land.

feature_functions.name: Physical behavior
feature_functions.function: Mirrors the front diaphragm and completes the symmetric load path between the saddle shell, side walls, and bottom rim.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Back exterior end face at Y=3, spanning the complete external width and height.
Back upper horizontal land at Z=0.75 between Y=2.4 and Y=3, adjacent to the exterior end and curved seat.
Back internal cavity end wall at Y=2.8, extending from the bottom opening to Z=0.55.
Back internal horizontal roof land at Z=0.55, joining the internal end wall to the cylindrical cavity roof.

sections.name: Bottom perimeter support rim and cavity opening

section_functions.name: Base interface
section_functions.function: Provides a planar annular support footprint at Z=-0.75 for seating the part against another component or reference surface.

section_functions.name: Open-bottom cavity
section_functions.function: The inner wire in the bottom face defines the rectangular cavity opening, reducing mass and allowing access to the internal shell surfaces.

section_functions.name: Structural tie
section_functions.function: The perimeter rim joins the two side walls and both end closures into a continuous closed frame around the cavity opening.

feature_functions.name: Support and stabilization
feature_functions.function: Creates a continuous flat bearing frame that stabilizes the saddle and distributes reaction loads around the open cavity.

feature_functions.name: Cavity access boundary
feature_functions.function: Its outer and inner boundary wires respectively define the external footprint and the open-bottom cavity aperture.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Bottom annular face at Z=-0.75 with two wires, forming the perimeter rim around the rectangular cavity opening.
